headline_hook: Anthropic Opens the Jailbreak Playbook as DeepMind Goes Hollywood

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Open-sourcing the attack playbook is Anthropic's bet that transparency accelerates defense faster than it arms attackers — and it forces every other lab to either match or explain why they won't.

model_literacy.relevance: Anthropic just published theirs in full. Understanding how labs systematically probe their own models — automated attack generation, graded severity taxonomies, regression suites — explains why 'jailbreak-proof' is a moving target, not a finish line.

items.title: Anthropic Publishes Its Full Jailbreak Evaluation Framework for Fable 5
items.angle: First frontier lab to open-source its red-team methodology at this level of detail — sets a new transparency bar for the industry
items.key_fact: Includes the complete jailbreak framework and cyber safeguard architecture used to evaluate Fable 5

items.title: High-Severity CVEs Spiked Around the Mythos Preview Launch Window
items.angle: First empirical data linking frontier model releases to vulnerability discovery rates — correlation or causation, the timing demands attention
items.key_fact: Statistically significant spike in newly reported high-severity CVEs timed with the Mythos Preview launch

items.title: Dispersion Loss Stops Small Language Models from Collapsing Their Embeddings
items.angle: A training technique that prevents embedding condensation in sub-3B models — potentially free performance if you're fine-tuning small models
items.key_fact: Targets the known embedding-space collapse problem that limits SLM quality

items.title: HuggingFace Transformers Ships Native KimiK 2.5–2.7 Support
items.angle: Moonshot's open multimodal agentic models now have first-class HF integration — the barrier to testing just dropped to pip install
items.key_fact: Transformers v5.13.0 adds native architecture support for KimiK 2.5, 2.6, and 2.7

items.title: Diffusers Brings NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Into the Standard Pipeline
items.angle: One model now handles world generation, physical reasoning, and action generation — unified world foundation models are arriving in production tooling
items.key_fact: Cosmos 3 is a Mixture-of-Transformers world foundation model, now available via diffusers v0.39.0

items.title: DeepMind and A24 Launch the First Frontier-AI-Meets-Film-Studio Research Partnership
items.angle: The first formal collaboration between a frontier lab and a major creative studio — expect it to define how AI tools enter professional creative workflows
items.key_fact: A24 is the first major film studio to formally partner with a frontier AI lab on creative workflow research

items.title: AIEWF Wraps With a Fight Over Agentic Loops and an H2 Roadmap
items.angle: The closing keynotes at AI Engineer World's Fair focused on what to build next — useful for setting your second-half priorities
items.key_fact: Featured a heated debate on agentic loop architectures and a comprehensive state-of-AI-engineering report

items.title: Vercel's Chief of Software: Skills, Sandboxes, and Agent-Readable Websites Are the New Primitives
items.angle: Concrete details on how Vercel rearchitected for agents — not an AI tab bolted on, but a rethink of what software ships as
items.key_fact: Vercel built an internal agent framework called 'eve' around skills, sandboxes, and agent-readable web surfaces

items.title: Simon Willison Maps the Gaps Between Open-Source and Closed AI
items.angle: A clear-eyed inventory of where open models still can't match closed providers — and where the biggest contributor opportunities lie
items.key_fact: Identifies specific capability gaps where open-source AI lags closed providers in production readiness

items.title: Claude Code Renames 'Default' to 'Manual' and Stops Auto-Continuing Dialogs
items.angle: If you run Claude Code in semi-autonomous mode, these UX changes affect your workflow — permission prompts now behave differently
items.key_fact: v2.1.200 renames 'default' permission mode to 'Manual' and stops AskUserQuestion dialogs from auto-continuing

items.title: llama.cpp Fuses 288-Expert MoE Routing Into a Single CUDA Kernel
items.angle: Three releases in two days slash routing overhead for massive MoE models — from 330 extra kernel launches to one fused call
items.key_fact: b9866 adds CUDA topk-MoE fusion for 288-expert models, cutting routing to one fused kernel at batch size 1

items.title: mcpsnoop: Wireshark for Model Context Protocol Debugging
items.angle: MCP tool calls have been a black box — this transparent proxy gives you a live TUI of every message between client and server
items.key_fact: Sits as a transparent proxy with live TUI visualization of all MCP messages

items.title: A Practical Guide to Running Frontier-Class Open Models Locally
items.angle: Hardware selection, quantization choices, and serving configs — everything you need if you're evaluating on-prem inference for privacy or latency
items.key_fact: 254 HN points — covers the full stack from hardware to serving for current SOTA open models
